sections.subheading: High-impact creative and digital visibility services to help your ministry grow its reach.

items.body: Optimize your church Google Business profile to rank #1 when believers search 'churches near me', 'Sunday service in [City]', or 'Christian fellowship'.

sections.heading: Four-step launch process
sections.subheading: A structured, prayerful, and collaborative development roadmap designed to respect your church calendar.

steps.title: Discovery & Giving Setup
steps.desc: We review your church departments, brand colors, leadership bios, and assist in configuring your verified MoMo merchant giving gateway.

steps.title: Design & App Development
steps.desc: Our team crafts the church website, builds the Android and iOS apps, imports sermon archives, and tests payment gateways under live test modes.

steps.title: Pastoral Walkthrough & Training
steps.desc: We conduct hands-on training sessions for church administrators, media team, and finance staff on uploading sermons and tracking tithe receipts.

steps.title: Sunday Service Launch
steps.desc: We prepare Sunday projector announcement slides and bulletin inserts to introduce the congregation to the new website and mobile giving app.

sections.heading: Investment & commercial terms
sections.subheading: Clear milestones, complete financial transparency, and strict member data privacy guarantees.

terms.title: Milestone payments
terms.body: 50% upfront commitment to initiate development and merchant integration, 30% upon approval of the website and mobile app preview, and 20% prior to final Sunday launch and app store publishing.

terms.title: 100% Financial & Data Ownership
terms.body: The church maintains exclusive ownership of all tithe, member, and financial records. Giving funds are settled directly by the telecom/bank into the church account with zero intermediary deductions.

terms.title: Church Media & Content Provision
terms.body: The church provides logo artwork, pastor bios, service times, and high-resolution photos of worship services and departmental leadership.

terms.title: Ongoing Technical Care & Warranty
terms.body: Includes 60 days of complimentary technical support, server security maintenance, and staff troubleshooting following public launch.

callout.label: Financial Transparency Notice:
callout.body: Development quotes are fixed investments. Payment gateway processing fees (typically 1.0% to 1.95% for Mobile Money and Card) are deducted standardly by the telecom networks directly into the church verified account.

sections.heading: Next steps to transform your digital ministry
sections.subheading: We are ready to partner with your church to build a digital presence worthy of the message you carry.
paragraphs: We recommend the Church Pro & Mobile App package at GH₵12,500 for active churches seeking to engage both local members and diaspora supporters with dedicated smartphone apps. For branch sanctuaries starting their digital journey, the Church Web & Online Giving package at GH₵5,800 delivers immediate online presence and Mobile Money donations.
To get started, simply reply to confirm your preferred package or schedule a complimentary 30-minute demonstration for your pastoral board.
